note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: # owner signs in once, off camera: az login --allow-no-subscriptions

Read-Host 'Owner: Inspection Field Inspector role assigned to alex.demo and sam.demo (admin center); both started the Power Apps self-service trial; the app Contoso Inspections is built per demo.md section C and published (Alex has 2-3 inspections); the phone is signed in as alex.demo. Press Enter'

screens.name: tables
steps: Solutions > ContosoInspections > Tables: Inspector, Site, Inspection, Inspection item with the cin_ prefix
Open Inspection > Columns: the Status choice
Open Inspection item > Columns: the Photo image column
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: new-app
steps: Solutions > ContosoInspections > New > App > Canvas app > Phone, name Contoso Inspections
Data pane: Inspections, Inspection items, Sites, Inspectors
Settings > Display: Scale to fit, Lock aspect ratio and Lock orientation off
App > Formulas
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: delegation
steps: Select galInspections > Items: no blue underline, no delegation warning
Temporarily replace StartsWith with Search: blue underline and delegation warning
Undo with Ctrl+Z
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: list
steps: Play InspectionsScreen in the phone preview as Alex Demo
Show the summary line, search INS-0000, chip In progress, rows newest first
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: new-inspection
steps: Tap New inspection (the screen says Alex Demo is inspecting)
Pick Harbor Warehouse > Start
Show the Draft status (number INS-000xx assigned by Dataverse)
Open the new inspection: Submit is disabled while it is a Draft
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: item
screens.app: Power Apps mobile (Android or iOS) on a real phone, recorded with the phone's own screen recorder
steps: Open the draft inspection > Add item, name 'Fire door', severity Major, Passed off, empty notes: show the message
Add notes: the message changes
Tap the camera and save: Draft becomes In progress, suggested score line appears
Try Critical with Passed on: 'A critical item cannot be marked as passed.'
mask: account name and avatar in Power Apps mobile
tenant name on the app list
notification bar (turn on Do Not Disturb)
device name

screens.name: responsive
screens.app: Power Apps mobile (Android or iOS) on a real phone, recorded with the phone's own screen recorder
steps: Open the in-progress inspection upright: one column
Rotate the phone: two panes
mask: account name and avatar in Power Apps mobile
tenant name on the app list
notification bar (turn on Do Not Disturb)
device name

screens.name: accessibility
steps: In Studio select the App checker icon > Accessibility tab
Show the issues and fix or note one
Cutaway: on the phone turn on TalkBack or VoiceOver and swipe through the list (no other notifications on screen)
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: offline
steps: Studio > Settings > General > Can be used offline on
New profile with current app data: Inspection, Inspection item, Site, Inspector; save and publish the profile, then the app
Cutaway on the phone: first sync, airplane mode on, add an item: globe with changes pending and the banner; airplane mode off
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
account name and avatar in Power Apps mobile
tenant name on the app list
notification bar (turn on Do Not Disturb)
device name

screens.name: monitor
steps: Studio > Advanced tools > Open monitor; play the app and save an item
Show the events, the Dataverse request and its duration
Optional: Apps > Contoso Inspections > Details > Live monitor > Play published app; turn Debug published app off afterwards
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
the monitor session id

screens.name: solution
steps: Solutions > ContosoInspections: four tables, the role Inspection Field Inspector, the app
Select the app > Advanced > Add required objects (adds the offline profile)
Export solution > Unmanaged
Cutaway in a terminal: pac solution unpack --zipfile <zip> --folder unpacked (offline)
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: share
steps: Apps > Contoso Inspections > Share
Add Alex Demo and Sam Demo
Data permissions: assign Inspection Field Inspector
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
real UPNs in the share panel

screens.name: phone
screens.app: Power Apps mobile (Android or iOS) on a real phone, recorded with the phone's own screen recorder
steps: Open Contoso Inspections from the app list: only Alex's list
New inspection > Add item with a photo > score, summary, follow-up on > Submit: row is Submitted, 'Waiting for the back office to review it.'
Then Sam Demo's phone or window: Alex's inspection is not listed
Optional: after Approved in the back office, pull to refresh: '✓ Approved' and the read-only banner
mask: account name and avatar in Power Apps mobile
tenant name on the app list
notification bar (turn on Do Not Disturb)
device name

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: delete the test inspections and items; remove Alex/Sam shares and the role if the app is not kept; delete the offline profile and the exported zip; az logout.'
